subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): scope memory_recall and memory_forget in a shared store

question: Should memory-lancedb ship caller-supplied scope partitions now even though scoped memories remain excluded from automatic recall and scopes are not bound to trusted session identity?
rationale: The implementation can enforce a caller-selected partition, but code inspection cannot decide whether that partial workflow and identity model is the intended long-term plugin contract.

options.title: Approve explicit scopes after repair
options.body: Land the partition primitive after moving schema upgrade work to plugin doctor, removing the unused agent field, and preserving explicit non-security-boundary documentation.

options.title: Wait for active-scope routing
options.body: Pause this PR until hook context can select and validate the current scope so scoped memories participate safely in automatic recall.

options.title: Decline the bundled surface
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin store-wide and leave advanced partition policy to external memory plugins that already expose richer scope models.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit scopes after repair
recommendation.body: Land the partition primitive after moving schema upgrade work to plugin doctor, removing the unused agent field, and preserving explicit non-security-boundary documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent bundled-plugin dependency work and review activity make this the best available routing candidate for the product and upgrade decision.
